title: Write the owner's tiny-fixes ruling into session-tiers
why:
Ruling own-tiny-fixes-b (owner 00:50 CST Nov 15, "so B", relayed by the consultant 00:55): any standing session sends one agent for a docs-only edit or small rule-text fix, one Sonnet reviewer in the same session for rule text, and merges its PR itself on green. Coordinator's call (00:51 CST): the lane writes the decision text in docs/decisions/session-tiers.md, extending "Work follows size", and sends the coordinator the CLAUDE.md sentence; the consultant's workflow PR carries that sentence. Lane started 00:51 CST Nov 15; session id verified by get_session 00:54 CST: lane tiny-fixes-b, running, connected, branch tiny-fixes-b, parent the coordinator, tag cs-step:tiny-fixes-b. Owner 00:53 CST asked to confirm that all claude-settings sessions auto-update as main merges land. Triage read 00:56 CST: PARTLY built. Built: the merge tool reinstalls the pinned ~/.claude checkout from origin's main after each merge (decision merge-reinstalls-from-main; merge.afterMerge runs merge/install_from_main.sh; PR #2601 merged 23:50 CST Nov 11, REST read). Not on main: a cloud session reinstalls at its next turn (step cloud-hooks-stale-copy, PR #3020, open draft per REST, last update Nov 13); a clean checkout fast-forwards at session start (step fast-forward-clean-start, PR #3141, open draft per REST, round 1 FAIL, last update Nov 13); each merge mails live sessions to refresh (step merge-mail-refreshes-sessions, doing, no PR read). So a long-running session does not update by itself yet; start-up and owner prompts remain its refresh points. Unread: whether any of these merged after the REST reads, and the merge-mail PR number. Consultant 00:59 CST Nov 15, ruling (a) on the lane's guard question: guard merge-role-proof is changed by lane tiny-fixes-b or a follow-up lane it names, so a standing session merges its own docs-only or rule-text PR through the merge tool; red first, normal guard review rounds. Until it merges, runner 10 merges these PRs. Ruling fb-1541-1 superseded for this class (not on roadmap). PR #3465 by REST 00:59 CST: open draft, head e4c530d5b199, 2 files, round 1 FAIL fixed, round 2 pending per its body. Lane's question (self-merge line vs fb-1541-1 and merge-role-proof) answered 00:58-00:59 CST Nov 15: coordinator's pick (runner 10 merges #3465 itself, PR writes the ruling and names the clash in Departs-from, follow-up lane aligns the guard) and consultant's (a) agree; follow-up filed as step merge-role-proof-follows-b. 01:03 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed): #3465 handed in, then sent back to its lane for three stale lines (86, 97 and 187 of session-tiers.md say "the coordinator never merges" with no exception); it returns to the coordinator after one fix push. REST read 01:03 CST: open draft, head 1a1c2119cf65 (the earlier head e4c530d5b199 is replaced), base main 36feed9702fc, mergeable_state blocked, 8 commits, 2 files, +8 -3. Its body lists round 3 FAIL on two small findings, then fix verifier PASS, and the three lines as open notes. Triage read no diff.

01:15 CST Nov 15 (coordinator pick, undoable, not the owner's): PR 3465 gets one fresh Sonnet read of the live head and a first tool-form record (no --fix-check, the tool has no earlier log to match). REST at about 01:15 CST: #3465 open draft, head 1efed4c8cd7f, base 36feed9702fc, clean, 10 commits, 2 files; its body lists round 1 haiku FAIL, round 2 sonnet FAIL, round 3 sonnet FAIL on two small findings, fix verifier sonnet PASS (prose); open notes: lines 86, 97 and 187 of session-tiers.md still say the coordinator never merges.

[14:10 CST Nov 15, triage] Owner chat 14:10 CST (relayed by the consultant; rulings own-consultant-builder-hat and own-no-new-sessions-now): the consultant finishes #3465 with its own subagents (adds the 12:09 and 14:10 rulings, fixes the consultant sentence) and merges it itself; ruling own-tiny-fixes-b (00:51 CST) never landed and #3465 is a draft (consultant's findings, unverified by triage). The 14:07 lane-vs-agent gap (decision lanes-start-as-agents) is noted; the 14:10 ruling goes into that record. (source: coordinator, relayed by triage; not owner-typed)
